_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：混合假設（if 子句與主句時間不一致）（eng.t_sub.subj.mixed，學測／分科級）。型A＝過去條件→現在結果：If ＋ 過去完成式(had p.p.), would ＋ 原形(now)；型B＝現在持續條件→過去結果：If ＋ 過去式, would have ＋ 過去分詞。高階防第二正解：以時間副詞（now／yesterday）與語境鎖定兩子句各自時間，避免誤用純過去或純現在假設。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 混合假設（if 子句與主句時間不一致）
units.can_do: 我能用混合假設：『過去條件→現在結果』(If ＋ had p.p., would ＋ 原形) 與『現在持續條件→過去結果』(If ＋ 過去式, would have ＋ 過去分詞)，並依句中時間線索選對兩子句的形式。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 混合假設 mixed conditionals
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Mixed type A links a PAST condition to a PRESENT result: 'If + past perfect (had + past participle), ... would + base form (now)': If I had taken that job, I would be in London now.
claims.verification_ref: 型A＝過去條件→現在結果：If ＋ had p.p., would ＋ 原形(now)；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Mixed type B links a PRESENT/ongoing condition to a PAST result: 'If + past simple, ... would have + past participle': If I were more organized, I would not have missed the deadline.
claims.verification_ref: 型B＝現在持續條件→過去結果：If ＋ 過去式, would have ＋ 過去分詞；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Time words show that the clauses refer to different times: a result with 'now / today' is present; a condition about a general, still-true state uses the past simple.
claims.verification_ref: 時間副詞（now／today）標示主句為現在；一直為真的狀態條件用過去式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In mixed conditionals, 'would' never goes in the if-clause: the past condition uses the past perfect (had + past participle), not 'would have'.
claims.verification_ref: would 不進 if 子句；過去條件用過去完成式 had p.p.；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A mixed conditional joins two different times. Type A links a PAST condition to a PRESENT result: use 'If + past perfect (had + past participle)' in the if-clause and 'would + base form' in the main clause, often with 'now'. 'If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now' means I did not study it, so I am not a doctor today.
teach.zh_hint: 混合假設把兩個不同時間連在一起。型A：過去條件→現在結果——if 子句用過去完成式(had ＋ 過去分詞)、主句用 would ＋ 原形，常搭配 now：If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now 代表「我當時沒唸醫、所以現在不是醫生」。

teach.body: If I had saved more money last year, I would be on vacation right now.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我去年多存點錢，現在就在度假了。had saved（過去）→ would be ... right now（現在）。

teach.body: Type B links a PRESENT/ongoing condition to a PAST result: use 'If + past simple' for the condition and 'would have + past participle' for the result. 'If I were more careful, I would not have broken the vase' means I am (generally) not careful, and that is why I broke it earlier. Remember: 'would' never goes in the if-clause.
teach.zh_hint: 型B：現在持續條件→過去結果——if 子句用過去式、主句用 would have ＋ 過去分詞。If I were more careful, I would not have broken the vase 代表「我（一向）不夠小心，所以之前打破了花瓶」。記住：would 永遠不放進 if 子句。

teach.body: If she were not afraid of flying, she would have joined us on the trip last week.
teach.zh_hint: 如果她不怕坐飛機，上週就會跟我們一起去旅行了。were afraid（現在持續狀態）→ would have joined ... last week（過去）。

practice.stem: 填入主句正確的形式（過去條件→現在結果）：If I had learned to drive, I ____ a car now.（如果我當時學了開車，現在就有車了）

distractor_rationales.would have owned: 結果是「現在」(now)，主句用 would ＋ 原形(would own)，不是 would have ＋ 過去分詞（那是過去結果）。
distractor_rationales.will own: 與事實相反的假設不用 will；現在結果用 would ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.owned: owned 是過去式，無法表達這裡『現在擁有』的假想結果；用 would own。

practice.feedback: 過去條件→現在結果：had learned → would own ... now。

practice.stem: 填入主句正確的形式（現在持續條件→過去結果）：If he were not so shy, he ____ to her at the party last night.（如果他不那麼害羞，昨晚在派對上就會跟她說話了）

distractor_rationales.would talk: 結果在「昨晚」(過去)，主句用 would have ＋ 過去分詞(would have talked)，不是 would ＋ 原形（那是現在結果）。
distractor_rationales.will talk: 與事實相反的假設不用 will；過去結果用 would have ＋ 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.had talked: had talked 是過去完成式，用在過去條件的 if 子句；此處是主句的過去結果，用 would have talked。

practice.feedback: 現在持續條件→過去結果：were not shy → would have talked ... last night。

practice.stem: 填入 if 子句正確的形式（過去條件→現在結果）：If they ____ the earlier flight, they would be home by now.（如果他們當時搭早一班飛機，現在就到家了）

distractor_rationales.took: 過去條件用過去完成式 had taken；過去簡單式 took 搭配的是與現在相反的純現在假設。
distractor_rationales.would take: would 不放進 if 子句；過去條件用 had taken。
distractor_rationales.would have taken: would 不放進 if 子句（×If they would have taken）；用過去完成式 had taken。

practice.feedback: 過去條件的 if 子句用過去完成式：If they had taken the earlier flight, they would be home by now。

practice.stem: 選出正確的混合假設句（過去條件→現在結果）：
practice.answer: If I had gone to bed earlier, I would not be so tired now.
options: If I had gone to bed earlier, I would not be so tired now.
If I had gone to bed earlier, I would not have been so tired now.
If I went to bed earlier, I would not be so tired now.
If I would have gone to bed earlier, I would not be so tired now.

distractor_rationales.If I had gone to bed earlier, I would no: 結果有 now（現在），主句要用 would ＋ 原形(would not be)，不是 would have been（過去結果）。
distractor_rationales.If I went to bed earlier, I would not be: 這是純現在假設（兩句都現在）；混合假設的過去條件要用過去完成式 had gone。
distractor_rationales.If I would have gone to bed earlier, I w: would 不放進 if 子句（×If I would have gone）；用 had gone。

practice.feedback: 過去條件→現在結果：If I had gone to bed earlier, I would not be so tired now。

practice.stem: 用混合假設寫出『過去條件→現在結果』：事實是『I did not learn English well in school, so I cannot get this job now.』（寫出：If I ____ English well in school, I ____ this job now.）
practice.answer: If I had learned English well in school, I could get this job now.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：過去條件 had learned（過去完成式）→ 現在結果 could get ... now（could ＋ 原形）。would get 亦可。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：留意兩子句的時間詞（now／last night）重讀，幫助聽者分辨混合時間；would／had p.p. 稍清楚。

lines.text: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Tokyo now.
lines.intonation: had taken 連讀、now 重讀、句尾下收

lines.text: If she were more patient, she would not have quit last month.
lines.intonation: were 稍強調、last month 重讀、句尾下收
